payload.reason: The evidence provides specific metrics and methods used to measure gender bias amplification in language generation models, including bias scores and comparisons of different model architectures.

claims.text: The bias amplification metric is computed for all models to study the effect of bias in text generation.
The bias score of a word is calculated using its word embedding and two gender indicators, allowing for the measurement of bias amplification.
Different model architectures, such as Seq2Seq and Seq2Seq+Attention, show varying levels of bias amplification, indicating the effectiveness of different approaches.
